definitions.explanation: The first public showing or introduction of a person, product, performance, or achievement to a wider audience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{披露目|ひろめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The unveiling of the new product took place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{披露目|ひろめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Relatives gathered for the baby's introduction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧⟦{役者|やくしゃ}→役者：05113_yakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{披露目|ひろめ}⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{連日|れんじつ}→連日：14328_renjitsu⟧⟦{満席|まんせき}→満席：07585_manseki⟧だった。
examples.english: The kabuki actor's debut performance was sold out every day.

notes:
Almost always said with お. In origin a term of the traditional performing arts, it is now used for any first public showing: a new product, a new building, a newborn baby shown to relatives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{披露目|ひろめ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to unveil, to show for the first time
- お{披露目|ひろめ}⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧: an unveiling event, a debut party
- お{披露目|ひろめ}⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧: a debut performance
- ⟦{新車|しんしゃ}→新車：11334_shinsha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{披露目|ひろめ}: the unveiling of a new car

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{披露|ひろう}→披露：09683_hirou⟧: showing, announcing — the plain noun, also in {結婚披露宴|けっこんひろうえん} (wedding reception)
- ⟦{初公開|はつこうかい}→初公開：18413_hatsukoukai⟧: first public showing (news and press-release style)
